input.overview: Advance the numbered Squad Cars in order. Car 5 lights PIK-5, while Mystery can be reached separately; either feature can randomly award Multiball, so there is no guaranteed lock sequence. If Multiball appears, choose Arrests or Points before launch, then complete Squad Cars 1 through 6 repeatedly for the selected award.
input.simpleOverview: Hit the flashing Squad Car numbers in order. Car 5 lights PIK-5; shoot the upper PIK-5 hole, or collect Mystery, for a chance at Multiball. If it is awarded, choose Arrests or Points, then complete Squad Cars 1 through 6 during Multiball.
input.summary: Advance the flashing Squad Cars to Car 5 and shoot the lit PIK-5 hole, or collect Mystery. Either can randomly start Multiball. Choose Arrests or Points, then complete Squad Cars 1 through 6 for the chosen award.

steps.text: Shoot the flashing Squad Car numbers in order until Car 5 lights PIK-5.
Shoot the upper hole while PIK-5 is lit, or collect Mystery, for a chance at the Multiball feature.
If Multiball is offered, choose Arrests or Points before the balls are released.
During Multiball, complete Squad Cars 1 through 6 to collect the displayed Arrest or point award.

alternatives.title: Build W-E-A-P-O-N
alternatives.when: Use this when Multiball is not awarded.

steps.text: Collect W-E-A-P-O-N letters from PIK-5 or Mystery, or collect Supercop to complete the word at once.
Complete W-E-A-P-O-N to begin Riot, then hit the flashing Crime Scenes.
Complete red or yellow Squad Car 7, then shoot the corresponding lit hole for an Add Badge award.
During Riot, hit the flashing Crime Scenes. During Multiball, complete Squad Cars 1 through 6 to collect the chosen Arrest award.

machineSetup: Confirm Mystery and PIK-5 award settings, extra-ball conversions, and whether Squad Car progress is shared or player-specific.
Test the numbered targets, both Add Badge holes, upper PIK-5 hole, Crime Scene targets, right-side targets, and ball release.

cautions.issue: Multiball is a random PIK-5 or Mystery feature.
cautions.response: Do not promise Multiball after a fixed number of shots; relight and collect a feature if another award appears.
